item.title: Zelda is breaking all preorder records
item.description:
>All major countries report it as the best selling game (US, Canada, Japan, France, Italy, Mexico, Germany, UK, Spain)
>Zelda OoT Remake has sold 100k copies in 5 days of preorders in the US
>Specialist retailers in Spain claim that for every GTA6 pre-order they’ve received 120 pre-orders for OoT.

This release is going to be massive.
